subject.title: [Bug] LINE channel: messages not delivered + Markdown table/code block rendering broken

question: Which LINE repair path should be canonical for this umbrella: land/review the focused open PRs, replace them with a narrower maintainer-owned fix, or split the remaining symptoms before accepting any broad behavior change?
rationale: The issue is valid at source level, but it bundles multiple LINE delivery and rendering policies with three live PR candidates, so automation should not choose the permanent repair shape or proof bar alone.

options.title: Review Focused PRs First
options.body: Use the existing open LINE PRs as the candidate fixes, require live LINE or explicit proof override for delivery-sensitive behavior, and split leftovers after those decisions.

options.title: Open A Narrow Replacement
options.body: Close or pause the broad contributor PRs and sponsor one maintainer-scoped replacement that covers only the agreed delivery/rendering contract.

options.title: Split Before Fixing
options.body: Keep all broad fixes paused and split this umbrella into separate rendering, Reply API batching, and retry/quota issues before implementation proceeds.

recommendation.title: Review Focused PRs First
recommendation.body: Use the existing open LINE PRs as the candidate fixes, require live LINE or explicit proof override for delivery-sensitive behavior, and split leftovers after those decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available routing owner from the history because he appears in the original LINE plugin provenance and recent current-main/PR history for the affected files.
